miniProject.title: Decoder variant with numerical and mechanism controls
miniProject.brief: Extend `lmlab` with a tested decoder variant and a bounded architecture comparison. Establish numerical and weight-transfer correctness before training, then distinguish mechanism evidence from parameter, routing, context and tuning effects using your existing corpus on your GPU or a reduced CPU decoder.
steps: Extend `model/` with your decoder from LLM Foundations and pass CS336 Assignment 1 model tests. Check frozen-batch objectives, norm and softmax gradients against float64 oracles; reconcile total/active parameters, FLOPs, saved activations and KV bytes with tensor inventories, hooks and analytical counts before training.

Choose a variant and reuse your weight maps and overlap tests: replicated GQA, uncompressed MLA, null RoPE scaling or gated-scan duality as applicable. Compare logits and gradients with the independent baseline or recurrence; retain lossy-conversion expectations and defect-catching regressions in `tests/`.

Reuse your capacity-limited MoE layer independently of the chosen variant. Check dispatch and combine against a per-token loop, assignment conservation and dropped residuals; verify gate, balance and router z-loss gradients against hand algebra, retaining precision conventions and analytical communication payloads.

Build the shape, causal-prefix, position-offset, padding, batch-independence, dtype and finite-difference battery; make every test reject a planted defect. Reuse initialization profiles across norm placements and depths; retain detached per-layer activation, gradient, attention-logit and growth summaries, with capacity-pressure exceptions tested separately.

Freeze an architecture contract in `registry/`: baseline, variant, null control and strongest simple alternative. Compare at matched tokens and declared parameter or compute budgets across paired seeds, retuning each arm equally; retain held-out records, resource counts, uncertainty and failed runs.

Run the bounded MoE balance, capacity and router z-loss campaign, changing controls separately at matched token and tuning budgets across paired seeds. Check language loss independently of auxiliary losses; retain per-layer loads, drops, entropy, logit scales and effects beside seed spread.

Test the chosen mechanism's risk with a held-out recall, context-length or routing-pressure probe against the baseline. Retain adverse or unresolved regimes, fine-tuning status and alternative explanations; regenerate tables from raw records and reproduce a comparison from clean state before recommending an architecture.
deliverables: The `model/` baseline and variant, reused MoE layer, property battery, weight maps and numerical oracles.
Count reconciliations, per-layer scale logs, MoE campaign and paired architecture comparisons with all attempts retained.
Mechanism-risk evidence, clean reproduction transcript and a hardware-scoped architecture decision in `reports/`.

checks.name: CS336 Assignment 1 model tests
checks.note: Guard the baseline with model snapshots; add independent gradient, mask, position, transfer and dtype checks for the variant.

rubric.pass: Your frozen-batch losses, gradients and transfer special cases match independent oracles before training. Tensor inventories reconcile parameter, operation, activation and KV counts; every property has a defect-catching regression.
rubric.strong: The first mismatching layer localizes a planted layout or precision fault, and the defense distinguishes lossy conversion from an implementation defect.

rubric.pass: Your loop and algebra oracles validate capacity, conservation, dropped residuals and auxiliary gradients. Paired campaigns retain per-layer load, entropy, drops and seed variation without assuming balance improves quality.
rubric.strong: A capacity-pressure counterexample explains a failed independence property, while the no-drop path still satisfies the exact equivalence contract.

rubric.pass: Matched budgets, paired seeds, equal tuning, null and simple controls support a bounded claim. Raw evaluation, failed runs, mechanism-risk probes and clean reproduction remain linked to immutable run identities.
rubric.strong: An adverse or inconclusive regime changes the recommendation; an independent rerun reproduces the comparison and its strongest alternative explanation.

miniProject.feedsInto: The tested decoder, variant, scale hooks and cost counts feed Pretraining Reliability and scaling. Weight-transfer regressions and matched architecture evidence become the capstone model manifest and mechanism controls.
